page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan. Left page: running head at top, page number 40 at upper left; a chapter heading (CAPUT VI, with its subtitle) centred above a tree diagram of the division of number; catchword at lower right. Right page: only its left edge is visible, cut off by the scan edge, with a few fragments of running text and a decorated initial. No margin notes on either page.

page.notes: The right page is cropped at the scan edge, so its lines are incomplete and only partly legible; the fragments are given as they show. The tree is an outline: the labels "Pariter"/"Impariter" and "par" are read from the braces at the right of the diagram, and the level depths are read from the drawing. Faint show-through of the text on the reverse is ignored. The "est'q;" reading in the box beside "Vno," is uncertain.
